card.title: 51st RIFLE BRIGADE
card.text: Gets +1+2 when you Convert one or more cards.
card.flavorText: The 51st Rifle Brigade was formed in October 1941 from military students and training units in the Volga Military District. Deployed in December, it joined the reserves of the Northwestern Front. In January 1942, the brigade participated in the Toropets–Kholm Offensive as part of the 4th Shock Army, which operated behind German lines. After months of combat, it was withdrawn to Kalinin in April. On April 21, 1942, the 51st Rifle Brigade was reorganized into the 119th Rifle Division. This new formation made use of the brigade's experienced personnel, allowing for rapid training and deployment. By November 1942, the division was engaged in Operation Uranus, the Soviet counteroffensive at Stalingrad. It was positioned within the Serafimovich bridgehead across the Don River and played a crucial role in encircling Axis forces. For its exemplary performance during the Stalingrad campaign, the 119th Rifle Division was raised to Guards status on December 16, 1942, becoming the 54th Guards Rifle Division. It later participated in major offensives across southern Ukraine, including the liberation of Makeevka, and advanced into Poland and Czechoslovakia. By the end of WWII, the division had earned multiple honors, such as the Orders of Lenin,  the Red Banner, Suvorov, and Kutuzov, before being disbanded in 1946.
